run_image_classification_demo: run image classification inference on an image file using a pretrained model config or name
build_image_classification_inferencer: build an ImageClassificationInferencer from a model config file and optional checkpoint path
run_inferencer_on_image: run the inferencer on an image file and print JSON prediction results to stdout

review_main_function: review the main function that parses CLI args and runs image classification inference via mmpretrain
